requests.ask: A note, outside FX2's files. FX1-7's proof FX1-T-11 (server/test/fix_fx1_audit_tools.test.mjs) fails on main 3bb18e3 in a fresh tree: 'FX1-T-11 no longer fails: it is fixed'. Its py() helper parses the last line of stdout+stderr. tools/check_document.py:505 has an invalid escape (\d) in a docstring, so Python 3.13 prints a SyntaxWarning to stderr whenever tools/__pycache__ holds no .pyc for it (py() runs -B). That warning is then the last line, the value is undefined, and stillOpen reads the proof as passing. With the .pyc cached, npm test passes 661 of 661. Either fix closes it: make that docstring raw (r"""), or have py() parse stdout only.
